context: Two engineers debug a spreadsheet formula
purpose: Teach: 関数/スポット/正面/披露/打つ/秩序/規約/日付

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この日付の欄、計算が合わないんだよね。関数のどこかが壊れてる気がする。
lines.en: The numbers in this date column don't match up. I feel like the function is broken somewhere.
lines.style: Calm senior engineer thinking aloud while scanning the sheet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと正面のモニターに映してもらえます？俺の画面じゃ細かいとこ見えなくて。
lines.en: Could you put it up on the monitor right in front? I can't see the details on my screen.
lines.style: Curious younger engineer leaning forward, wants a better view.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほら、ここのVLOOKUP。引数の順序がぐちゃぐちゃで、参照先がずれてる。
lines.en: Look, this VLOOKUP here. The order of the arguments is a mess and the reference is off.
lines.style: Patient explainer pointing at the formula bar.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あー、これ前任者が組んだやつですよね。コード全体に秩序がなくて、社内の規約とも全然合ってないし。
lines.en: Ah, this is the one the previous person built, right? The whole code lacks any order, and it doesn't follow our internal rules at all.
lines.style: Slightly exasperated teen recognizing legacy code and complaining.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: とりあえず修正する前に、怪しい箇所を全部マークしておこう。後で戻れるように。
lines.en: Before we start making fixes, let's mark all the suspicious spots first so we can roll back later.
lines.style: Methodical mentor proposing a safe debugging approach to the junior.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解です。あ、ここの日付、文字列で入ってますよ。だから引き算が効かないのか。
lines.en: Got it. Oh, the date here is stored as text. That's why the subtraction isn't working.
lines.style: Excited junior catching a real bug in the data with enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お、ナイス発見。このバグの多発スポット、DATEVALUEで包んじゃおう。
lines.en: Oh, nice catch. This bug hotspot, let's just wrap it with DATEVALUE.
lines.style: Pleased senior praising and proposing a concrete fix on the spot.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ俺、キーボード打つの早いんで入力やりますよ。直ったら部長に披露しましょう。
lines.en: Then since I type fast on the keyboard, I'll do the input. Once it's fixed, let's show it off to the manager.
lines.style: Eager teen volunteering and looking forward to the demo moment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: よし、頼んだ。やっぱ二人で見ると早いな。
lines.en: Alright, you got it. Debugging really is faster with two people, huh.
lines.style: Relieved senior grinning at the small victory together.
